# Pokemon Champions Guide

> Pokemon Champions Guide is an English strategy site for Pokemon Champions PvP team building, tier lists, useful Pokemon recommendations, Pokemon HOME transfer guidance, mobile launch preparation, and Mega build references.

Base URL: https://pokemetahub.com

## Core Pages

- https://pokemetahub.com/tier-list - Single Battle and Double Battle Pokemon Champions tier lists with local Pokemon images and concise ranking reasons.
- https://pokemetahub.com/useful-pokemon - Mega Pokemon, utility Pokemon, and damage dealer recommendations with moves, natures, abilities, EVs, stats, and item images.
- https://pokemetahub.com/best-teams - Battle-ready Single and Double Battle team builds with complete movesets, natures, abilities, EV spreads, stats, and local item images.
- https://pokemetahub.com/beginner-guide - Beginner guide covering battle modes, Single vs Double Battle, first-team building, and Ranked preparation.
- https://pokemetahub.com/pokemon-home - Pokemon HOME transfer overview with careful compatibility guidance.
- https://pokemetahub.com/mobile-release - Pokemon Champions iOS and Android release guide for the June 17, 2026 mobile launch.
- https://pokemetahub.com/mega-raichu - Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y build overview and counters.

## Editorial Notes

- Content is written in English for Pokemon Champions players searching for PvP strategy.
- Images are served from local site assets rather than third-party runtime URLs.
- Build recommendations are launch-window guidance and should be updated as the metagame changes.
